title: India, UAE partner on AI sovereignty to bypass Google, Microsoft
summary: India and UAE are forming a strategic AI partnership to develop sovereign AI infrastructure, working with Abu Dhabi-based AI company G42 and chip manufacturer Cerebras to reduce dependence on American tech giants like Google and Microsoft.
problem_solved: Addresses AI sovereignty concerns by enabling nations to build independent AI capabilities without relying on US or Chinese technology providers.
why_valuable: Represents a significant geopolitical shift where nations seek technological independence and data sovereignty in AI development, potentially reshaping global AI power dynamics.
